title: Tequila Explained
description: Tequila has deep cultural roots, complex production and a wide range of styles. Learn its story from ancient origins to modern cocktails, and how to drink, mix and appreciate it, with expert-led videos and quizzes.
topics: The history of tequila, from pulque to premium
How tequila is made, from agave to distillation
Styles: Blanco, Reposado, Añejo, Extra Añejo and Mixto
How to drink tequila: neat, with food and in cocktails
